[NSTG.1.1] Per LSTO.1 the language commits to three
storage planes, each tuned to a different question. The facts and samples
planes are deferred ([NSTG.3], [NSTG.5]); in this edition the libds wiring is
the cache plane's:

| Plane | Question | libds callback | Loss semantics |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Cache**   | "what is the current value?"    | engine-owned ([LSTO.4.7]); `ds_engine_cache_callbacks` (C3) is **optional** write-through persistence | in-session must-not-lose (engine); cross-restart via the optional hook |
